changelog:
v2.6.1 — APP FREEZER HOTFIX:

🎯 Found it: the freezer wasn't freezing anything on Shizuku mode. Root cause — pm suspend needs a permission (SUSPEND_APPS) that the shell identity doesn't have, so every tap failed silently and apps stayed ACTIVE forever.

✅ FIXED: switched to pm disable-user / pm enable — the real shell-permitted non-root freeze technique (same one Shelter/Island/Hail use). Tap an app now and it actually freezes.

✅ Added error messages in the Freezer card — if anything fails now, you'll see exactly why instead of silence.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.0.
